meta.tagline: Mauritania, seen by its own people.
meta.description: SOURA gathers photographs of Mauritania taken by the people who live there. Discover the images, then contact the photographers directly.

footer.statement: Photographers keep all their rights. Originals are never downloadable: any use is agreed directly with the author.

common.demoNotice: Demo content: generated images, no real photographers.
common.photoCount: {count, plural, =0 {no photos} one {# photo} other {# photos}}
common.draftLegal: Draft — must be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to this action.
errors.email_unverified: Please confirm your email address first — we sent you a link.
errors.account_suspended: This account is suspended. Write to us if you think this is a mistake.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is safer than a complicated word.
auth.displayNameHint: The name your photographs will be credited to.
auth.loginLead: Sign in to manage your photographs and profile.
auth.signupLead: A photographer account is free. Your images are checked by our team before they are published.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <rules>content rules</rules>.
auth.checkEmailBody: If {email} can be used, a confirmation link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 48 hours.
auth.resent: If an unconfirmed account exists, a new link has been sent.
auth.verifiedBody: Welcome to SOURA. Complete your profile, then submit your first photograph.
auth.verifyFailed: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
auth.forgotLead: Enter your address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account exists for this address, a link valid for one hour has been sent.
auth.resetDone: Password changed. You are signed in.
auth.unverifiedBody: Confirm your email address to sign in. Didn’t receive anything?

email.verifyBody:
Hello {name},

To activate your SOURA account, open this link (valid for 48 hours):
{url}

If you didn’t sign up, ignore this message.
email.existingBody:
Hello,

Someone tried to create a SOURA account with this address, which already has one. If it was you, sign in or reset your password:
{url}

Otherwise you can ignore this message.
email.resetBody:
Hello,

To choose a new password, open this link (valid for one hour):
{url}

If you didn’t ask for this, ignore this message — your password stays the same.

notFound.title: This image doesn’t exist — or no longer does.
notFound.body: The link may be incomplete, or the photo was removed by its author.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong.
errorPage.body: We couldn’t display this page. Try again in a moment.
